```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Url;
use Illuminate\Auth\CanSeeBeforeRenderException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Guard;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Laravel\Authorization\Authorizable;
use Laravel\Authorization\Gate;
use Laravel\Authorization\Macroable;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\Access\AuthorizesResources;

class UrlPolicy implements Authorizable, Macroable
{
    use AuthorizesResources;
    use Gate; // Import the Gate facade for authorization

    public function viewAny(User $user)
    {
        // Check if the user has access to view any URL records
        return $this->authorize('view', Url::class);
    }

    public function view(User $user, Url $url)
    {
        // Check if the user has access to view a specific URL record
        return $this->authorize('view', $url);
    }

    public function create(User $user)
    {
        // Check if the user has permission to create new URL records
        return $this->authorize('create', Url::class);
    }

    public function update(User $user, Url $url)
    {
        // Check if the user has permission to update a specific URL record
        return $this->authorize('update', $url);
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Url $url)
    {
        // Check if the user has permission to delete a specific URL record
        return $this->authorize('delete', $url);
    }
}
```
